title: CC: Tweaked Volume Config
description: This add-on adds a configuration option for the maximum volume of speakers in CC:Tweaked
body:
### How it works
This add-on overrides speaker class, so it allows you to configure max volume by redacting config file. (in original CC tweaked the volume is limited by 3.0 and not configurable) 


## Permission
You are free to use this mod as you want.
